run_rerank_cohere: run rerank to reorder documents by relevance to a query using the Cohere provider
run_rerank_together_ai: run rerank to reorder documents by relevance using Together AI with model and top_n parameters
run_rerank_bedrock: run rerank to reorder documents by relevance using AWS Bedrock with optional chunking params
run_rerank_async: run async rerank to reorder documents by relevance to a query using arerank
run_rerank_watsonx: run rerank to reorder documents by relevance using IBM WatsonX with credentials
